title: 09. Production & Safety: Tool Metrics
summary: Covers Tool Selection + Argument Correctness, Tool Execution Success + Output Quality.

sections.title: Tool Selection + Argument Correctness
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  TOOL SELECTION = "Right tool chosen for the request?"         │
│  TOOL ARGS      = "Right arguments passed to the tool?"        │
│                                                                 │
│  Example Request: "What is 45 * 67?"                           │
│                                                                 │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  CASE 1: Perfect                                         │  │
│  │  Tool: calculator  ✅                                    │  │
│  │  Args: {"expression": "45 * 67"}  ✅                     │  │
│  │  Selection: 1.0   Args: 1.0                              │  │
│  │                                                          │  │
│  │  CASE 2: Right tool, slightly different args             │  │
│  │  Tool: calculator  ✅                                    │  │
│  │  Args: {"expression": "45*67"}  (no spaces) ✅           │  │
│  │  Selection: 1.0   Args: 0.9  (functionally same)        │  │
│  │                                                          │  │
│  │  CASE 3: Wrong tool                                      │  │
│  │  Tool: web_search  ❌                                    │  │
│  │  Args: {"query": "45 * 67"}                              │  │
│  │  Selection: 0.0   Args: 0.0                              │  │
│  │                                                          │  │
│  │  CASE 4: Hallucinated tool (doesn't exist!)              │  │
│  │  Tool: math_engine_v2  ❌ (not in tool registry)         │  │
│  │  → Hallucination Check = 0.0                             │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                                                                 │
│  ARGUMENT SCORING LOGIC:                                        │
│  Key Overlap  = shared keys / expected keys  (weight: 40%)     │
│  Value Match  = matching values / expected keys (weight: 60%)  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

sections.title: Tool Execution Success + Output Quality
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  EXECUTION SUCCESS = "Did the tool run without error?"         │
│  OUTPUT QUALITY    = "Was the tool output useful?"             │
│                                                                 │
│  EXECUTION SUCCESS EXAMPLES:                                    │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  calculator("sqrt(144)")  → {"result": 12}   Score: 1.0  │  │
│  │  calculator("sqrt(-1)")   → {"error": "..."}  Score: 0.0 │  │
│  │  web_search("AI agents")  → 429 rate limit   Score: 0.5  │  │
│  │  (retried successfully)   → {"results": ...} Score: 0.5  │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                                                                 │
│  OUTPUT QUALITY — Keyword overlap between output and request:   │
│  Request: "Find information about LangGraph"                    │
│  Output:  "LangGraph is a stateful agent workflow framework"    │
│  → Common words: {langraph, agent, workflow} → Score: 0.75 ✅  │
│                                                                 │
│  Request: "Find information about LangGraph"                    │
│  Output:  "Error: connection timeout"                           │
│  → Score: 0.0 ❌ Error output                                  │
│                                                                 │
│  HALLUCINATION CHECK:                                           │
│  Available tools: [web_search, calculator, weather_api]         │
│  Agent calls: code_interpreter_v3  ← NOT in registry           │
│  → Hallucination detected! Score: 0.0 ❌                       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
